facts.fact: exp.metal() selects the Metal GPU device
the first Metal render of a session takes longer than the second (kernel load / scene upload)
at 384x384, 128 samples, no denoising, the M2 Pro GPU (Metal) renders this scene faster than its 12 CPU threads
GPU and CPU renders of the same scene, seed and samples agree in mean value to within 1 %
two GPU renders with the same seed are not bit-identical, but agree to within 1e-4 per pixel
GPU and CPU renders with the same seed draw the same noise pattern: they differ by at most 0.01 per pixel, far less than the noise itself at 128 samples
